column2: How do I see only newspapers, records or military sites in “🌍 Where to search?”?
column3: Above the list, a row of badges per kind of source (📜 Records, 📰 Newspapers, 🎖 Military, 🚢 Emigration…) shows the number of sites: one click keeps only that kind, several = one or the other. The same boxes are in “Filter ▾”, with the country, “Free only” and “In French only”. The choice is remembered for everyone; “Clear all” removes it. On a record, “🎖 All military” opens the filtered page without changing that choice. When nothing is left, the page says why (sites set aside and their reasons).

column2: Is this record online at the archives? (🟢 🟡 📮 🔒 ❔ badges)
column3: On a record, next to each birth, baptism, marriage, death and burial: 🟢 online (verified limit for this département), 🟡 maybe, 📮 to request (and from whom: town hall, departmental archives, Central civil registry, ANOM, diocesan archives…), 🔒 restricted until a given year (75 years), ❔ to check. A click explains why, with the official page and its check date. ✓ “I found it online” or ✗ “Not online” corrects the limit for the whole département or just the commune. The app never visits the archives’ website: it opens the page. Timeline and Events list: Settings → 🏛 Online records at the archives.
